you’ve always been the thought in every 11:11 i make, and today, i have something special i want to tell you. honestly, i know you probably have an idea of what i’m about to say, pero gusto ko talaga gawin habang tulog ka : ) para pag gising mo, surprise na lang HAHAHAHAHA.

first, thank you for being so patient with me, babyyy. mapa-yearning, panliligaw, paghihintay, or simply being there kahit hindi mo alam kung kailan ako magiging ready ulit. i know waiting wasn’t always easy, but you never made me feel rushed. you gave me time to figure out my feelings, and you stayed even when you weren’t sure where things were headed. i hope you know how much i appreciate that. you made me feel like i was worth waiting for, and i’ll always be grateful for that.

after everything we’ve been through, it’s honestly heartwarming to see where we are now. we’ve had our misunderstandings, difficult moments, and time apart, but somehow, we found our way back to each other. i don’t expect everything to be perfect this time, and i know we’ll still have days when things get difficult. but i hope we continue choosing to understand each other, communicate, and grow together. i want us to do things better, not out of fear of losing each other, but because we genuinely want to make this work.

i may not always know how to suklian all the love, time, and effort you’ve given me, but i’ll keep trying. i want you to feel just as loved, appreciated, heard, and chosen. and baby, you don’t always have to be okay or figure everything out on your own. you can tell me about your worries, your random thoughts, and even the things you find difficult to put into words. i’ll always want to understand you. all will be alright in time, babyyy.

i’m genuinely happy that after everything, it’s still you. ikaw pa rin yung gusto kong makasama sa random kwento, late-night talks, kulitan, tampuhan, tawanan, and all the little moments in between. i’m excited for the memories we haven’t made, the pictures we haven’t taken, and all the ordinary days we’ll get to share. i hope we never get too comfortable that we forget to make each other feel loved.

mahal na mahal kita, baby. thank you for waiting, for being patient with me, and for still wanting us after everything. i don’t take this opportunity lightly, and i hope you never doubt how much you mean to me. i’m grateful that we get to have another chapter together, and i want to make the most of it with you.
